# Bosco Labs data APIs

> Bosco Labs publishes data tools for AI agents and analysts as Apify Actors that return clean, typed JSON from official sources: SEC filings, insider trades, 13F holdings and XBRL financials, US House STOCK Act trades, European ESEF annual reports, UK/Danish/Norwegian company accounts and registries, sanctions lists, EU, UK and Dutch law and case law, EU tenders, US federal and Pentagon contract awards, ECB rates and euro inflation, clinical trials, Dutch addresses, plus PDF-to-JSON and Apify dataset tools. Each Actor runs on the Apify platform via API or MCP and is priced per result (pay per event). Data rows carry a source link. Tools marked 'coming soon' are built but not yet public on the Store.

Apify Store profile: https://apify.com/bosco_labs
Contact: support@boscolabs.dev

## Finance & SEC

- [SEC Insider Trading API (Form 4): live + history since 2006](https://boscolabs.dev/sec-insider-trades.html): Every insider purchase and sale reported on SEC Form 4 (directors, officers, 10% owners), from official EDGAR filings, 2006 to today, with cluster-buy and cluster-sell signals; filter by ticker, CIK, transaction code, role, value and date. Price: $0.0018 per transaction row and $0.02 per cluster signal. ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/sec-insider-trades))
- [SEC EDGAR Filings API: 8-K, 10-K, 10-Q feed since 1994](https://boscolabs.dev/sec-filings-feed.html): SEC EDGAR filings (8-K, 10-K, 10-Q, S-1, 13D, 13G, Form 4 and every other form) for any company or the whole market, live or back to 1994, from the SEC's own feeds; 8-K item codes and earnings releases (Item 2.02); links to each filing, not its text. Price: $0.001 per filing. ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/sec-filings-feed))
- [Congress Stock Trades API: US House STOCK Act since 2014](https://boscolabs.dev/us-house-trades.html): Congress stock trades: stock, option, fund and bond trades that US House members disclose in STOCK Act Periodic Transaction Reports, from the Clerk of the House's official filings since January 2014 (no Senate); ticker, amount range, owner, days to disclose. Price: $0.0018 per trade. ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/us-house-trades))
- [SEC Ownership API: 13F Holdings, 13D/13G Stakes, Form 144](https://boscolabs.dev/sec-ownership.html): Who owns a stock and who is selling, from official SEC filings: a fund's 13F holdings with quarter-over-quarter changes, the funds holding a ticker, 5%+ stakes (13D activist, 13G passive) and Form 144 planned insider sales. One ticker or fund in, small JSON out, a source link per row. Price: $0.0018 per row. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [SEC Company Financials API: income, balance sheet, cash flow](https://boscolabs.dev/sec-company-financials.html): US company financials from SEC XBRL: revenue, profit, EPS, balance sheet, cash flow, free cash flow and margins per fiscal year or quarter, 2009 to today. By ticker or CIK, 10-K/10-Q and 20-F filers. Each value cites its XBRL tag and SEC filing. Q4 derived where not reported. Price: $0.005 per company-period row. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [SEC Company Screener API: filter all US filers by financials](https://boscolabs.dev/sec-company-screen.html): US companies matching your filters for one calendar year or quarter: revenue, net income, margins, cash flow, assets and 30 more metrics from SEC XBRL frames, sorted and capped. Each value cites its XBRL tag and SEC filing. Same metrics as SEC Company Financials. Price: $0.002 per company returned. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [EU Annual Reports API (ESEF): XBRL financial statements](https://boscolabs.dev/esef-annual-reports.html): Normalized key financials (revenue, EBIT, EBITDA, net income, EPS, assets, equity, cash flows, margins, growth) of European listed companies from official ESEF annual reports via filings.xbrl.org; 28 countries; every value linked to its XBRL fact. Price: $0.01 per run plus $0.05 per annual report; raw XBRL fact rows, if switched on, $0.0005 each. ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/esef-annual-reports))

## Companies

- [Company Check API: identity, financials & SEC filings in 1 call](https://boscolabs.dev/company-check.html): One company report per call: legal name, LEI, registration number, status, address and industry, years of revenue, profit, equity, assets and cash, SEC filings and FDIC bank data. Look up by name, LEI, UK, DK, NO, FR, FI or EE number, ticker, CIK or FDIC cert. Sourced values. Price: $0.03 per report. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [Company Financials API: UK, Denmark & Norway accounts + LEI](https://boscolabs.dev/company-accounts.html): Financials (revenue, profit, equity, assets, cash, employees) of private and public companies from official accounts: UK Companies House, Denmark Erhvervsstyrelsen, Norway Brønnøysund; adds the LEI from GLEIF and a source per value. Price: $0.04 per company-year. ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/company-accounts))
- [UK New Companies API: daily Companies House incorporations](https://boscolabs.dev/uk-new-companies.html): New UK companies incorporated on any day (default: yesterday) from the official Companies House API: number, name, type, status, SIC codes with descriptions, registered office address and a register link. Filter by SIC prefix, location and type. No director data. Price: $0.002 per company. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [Company Hiring Signals API: open roles, departments, locations](https://boscolabs.dev/company-hiring-signals.html): Is a company hiring? Open roles by department, location and remote share, newest and oldest posting dates and top titles, plus job rows with a link each. Read from the company's public Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby job board. Look up by name, domain or board URL. Price: $0.005 per company found plus $0.001 per job row. (coming soon to the Apify Store)

## Compliance & law

- [Sanctions Screening API: OFAC, UK, EU & US export lists](https://boscolabs.dev/sanctions-screening.html): Is this company, vessel or person sanctioned? Returns per name: match yes/no, the listed entry, aliases, programs, listing date, identifiers and a source link, from the official OFAC SDN and non-SDN, US Consolidated Screening List, UK Sanctions List and EU lists, with each list's date. Price: $0.01 per name screened. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [EU Law Lookup API (EUR-Lex): article text, in force, amendments](https://boscolabs.dev/eu-law-lookup.html): The text of an EU law article as in force today (or on a date), whether the act is in force, what amended it, plus new Official Journal acts. Ask by name (GDPR, AI Act), citation, CELEX or ELI; 24 languages. Official EUR-Lex/Cellar data with a source link per row. Price: $0.01 per act or article returned. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [UK & Dutch Law Lookup API: article text by date, in force](https://boscolabs.dev/national-law-lookup.html): The text of a UK section or Dutch article as in force today (or on a date), whether it is in force and what changed it. Ask by citation: "Companies Act 2006 s 172", "BW 7:658", "artikel 13 Wet Vpb 1969". Official legislation.gov.uk and Dutch BWB data with a source link per row. Price: $0.01 per article or act returned. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [Dutch Case Law API (Rechtspraak): ECLI lookup, uitspraken](https://boscolabs.dev/dutch-case-law.html): Dutch court decisions (uitspraken) by ECLI or search: court, dates, case numbers, legal area, summary (inhoudsindicatie), appeal/cassation relations, law references and optional text. Hoge Raad, Raad van State, gerechtshoven, rechtbanken. Official Rechtspraak Open Data, source link per row. Price: $0.005 per decision returned. (coming soon to the Apify Store)

## Government & procurement

- [EU Public Tenders & Contract Awards API (TED procurement)](https://boscolabs.dev/eu-tenders.html): EU public procurement notices from TED (Tenders Electronic Daily), the EU's official tenders journal: open calls with deadlines, contract awards with winners and values, prior information; EU, EEA and more, since 2016; filter by keyword, country, CPV code, notice type, date, EUR value. Price: $0.002 per notice. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [Pentagon / DoD Contract Awards API: winners, amounts, tickers](https://boscolabs.dev/dod-contract-awards.html): US Department of Defense contract awards of $7.5M or more the same evening they are announced, plus USAspending.gov history since FY2008 (any federal agency); winner, amount, service, NAICS/PSC, matched to a US stock ticker with SEC shares outstanding. Price: $0.005 per award row. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [US Federal Awards API: contracts & grants, all agencies](https://boscolabs.dev/us-federal-awards.html): US federal contract, grant and loan awards from every agency (USAspending.gov): winner, UEI, parent company, stock ticker, agency, amounts, dates, NAICS/PSC/assistance listing, place of performance and a source link. Filter by company, ticker, agency, keyword, state, date. Price: $0.004 per award row. (coming soon to the Apify Store)

## Macro, health & places

- [ECB Rates & Euro Inflation API: policy rates, FX, €STR, HICP](https://boscolabs.dev/eu-rates-inflation.html): Latest value, previous value, change and recent history of ECB policy rates, euro reference FX rates, €STR, euro-area and national bond yields, and Eurostat HICP inflation. Ask by plain name (ecb_deposit_rate, eur_fx:USD, hicp:NL), no SDMX keys. Official data, a source link per series. Price: $0.002 per series returned. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [ClinicalTrials.gov API: trial search & NCT dossier](https://boscolabs.dev/clinical-trials.html): Clinical trials as compact JSON rows: status, phase, sponsor, conditions, interventions, enrollment, start and primary completion dates, countries, outcomes and results. Look up NCT numbers or search by condition, drug, sponsor, phase, status, country and dates. Sourced, no contact data. Price: $0.004 per trial. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [Dutch Address Lookup API: BAG postcode, geocode & building data](https://boscolabs.dev/dutch-address-lookup.html): Validates and geocodes Dutch addresses against the official BAG register (via PDOK): postcode, BAG ids, WGS84 + RD coordinates, construction year, use, floor area and building status. Free text, postcode + house number (or range) or BAG ids; up to 100 per run. Unmatched inputs are free. Price: $0.002 per resolved address. (coming soon to the Apify Store)

## Data tools

- [PDF to JSON API: text, tables and metadata from a PDF URL](https://boscolabs.dev/pdf-to-data.html): PDF text, tables and metadata as clean JSON from 1-20 public PDF URLs or a base64 file: per-page markdown text in reading order, tables as rows with a header guess, title, author and dates. Processed in memory, never stored. Pay per page with text; scanned pages are flagged and free. Price: $0.0005 per page with text. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [Deduplicate & Merge Apify Datasets: remove duplicate items](https://boscolabs.dev/dataset-dedup.html): Deduplicate and merge one or more Apify datasets (or a pasted JSON array): removes duplicate items by any fields (dot paths allowed) or by the whole item, keeping the first or last occurrence; streams millions of items with constant memory. Price: $0.00015 per unique item written (duplicates are free). (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [Change Monitor: new, changed & removed items + Slack alerts](https://boscolabs.dev/dataset-change-monitor.html): Run any scraper on a schedule and get only what changed: new, changed and removed items compared with the previous run, matched by your key fields (e.g. url). Optional Slack, Discord, Telegram, email or webhook alert per run. Add it as an integration to your scraper. Price: $0.001 per change reported. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [Google Sheets Export: send any Apify dataset to a spreadsheet](https://boscolabs.dev/sheets-export.html): Export any Apify dataset to Google Sheets: replace a tab or append rows, with nested fields as columns and your header kept; writes with your own Google service account key and retries Google rate limits. Price: $0.00015 per row exported. (coming soon to the Apify Store)

## How to call

- Apify API (synchronous): POST `https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/bosco_labs~<actor>/run-sync-get-dataset-items` with header `Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>` and the Actor input as the JSON body; the response is the dataset items.
- Apify hosted MCP server: add `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/<actor>` to your MCP client (Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ...). It loads the Actor as a tool plus `get-actor-run` and `get-dataset-items`, and signs you in with OAuth or `Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>`. On the default server (`https://mcp.apify.com`) agents can also find the Actors with `search-actors` and run them with `call-actor`.
- Pricing: pay per event, billed to your own Apify account: you pay for rows delivered at the prices listed per Actor, and runs stop at your max charge limit.
- Bosco Labs HTTP API: `POST https://api.boscolabs.dev/v1/<tool>` with `Authorization: Bearer <key>` for 8 fast lookups (same input and rows as the Actors), prepaid credits, $0.50 free trial; remote MCP at `https://api.boscolabs.dev/mcp`. Keys, prices and limits: https://boscolabs.dev/api.html
- Contact: support@boscolabs.dev (questions, data issues, custom data requests).
- Bosco Labs MCP server: `bosco-labs-data-mcp` on PyPI (https://pypi.org/project/bosco-labs-data-mcp/) and the official MCP Registry (`io.github.PB7-debug/bosco-labs-data`): one MCP server for all data Actors. Run it with `uvx bosco-labs-data-mcp` and set `APIFY_TOKEN`; source in https://github.com/PB7-debug/bosco-labs-data/tree/main/mcp.

## API (beta, test mode)

- Base URL: https://api.boscolabs.dev; `POST /v1/<tool>` with header `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (or `X-API-Key`) and the Actor's input object as JSON body; the response holds the Actor's rows plus `charged_usd` and `balance_usd`.
- OpenAPI: https://api.boscolabs.dev/openapi.json; interactive docs: https://api.boscolabs.dev/docs; catalogue with prices and input schemas: https://api.boscolabs.dev/v1/tools (free)
- Remote MCP (streamable HTTP, same key header): https://api.boscolabs.dev/mcp
- [Get a key, prices and limits](https://boscolabs.dev/api.html): prepaid credits, packs $10, $50, $200, one-time $0.50 free trial per verified e-mail; prices exclude VAT
- [Privacy](https://boscolabs.dev/privacy.html): request bodies (names screened, queries) are never logged or stored
- `company-check`: $0.03 per company report (max 1 report).
- `sec-company-financials`: $0.005 per company-period row (max 10 tickers/CIKs x 20 years).
- `sec-company-screen`: $0.002 per company returned (max 200 companies (maxResults)).
- `sec-filings-feed`: $0.001 per filing (max 200 filings (maxResults)).
- `sanctions-screening`: $0.01 per name screened (max 50 names). This product uses the International Trade Administration's Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the International Trade Administration. OFAC and CSL data are US government works. UK Sanctions List: contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. EU list: European Commission, names as published. No endorsement by any publisher is implied.
- `eu-law-lookup`: $0.005 per act or article returned (max 50 results (maxResults)). Consolidated texts from EUR-Lex (© European Union) are a documentation tool with no legal effect; only the acts published in the Official Journal of the European Union are authentic.
- `national-law-lookup`: $0.005 per article or act returned (max 10 articles). UK: contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (© Crown and database right, legislation.gov.uk).
- `eu-rates-inflation`: $0.002 per series returned (catalogue free) (max 20 series). Source: ECB statistics (data.ecb.europa.eu). The data are free of charge from the ECB; we charge for processing and delivery, not for the data. Eurostat HICP: © European Union, free of charge from Eurostat. The change field is computed by Bosco Labs.
